title: Scientific Closure and v0.37 Entry Boundary

scientific_disposition.label: ROBUSTNESS_EVALUATION_BLOCKED_BY_INACTIVE_SELECTOR_PREREQUISITE
scientific_disposition.interpretation: Formal robustness evaluation of the v0.35 mechanism as an active learned intervention is inadmissible because the selector failed its prospectively required discrimination and activation prerequisites. v0.36 therefore closes without executing a robustness benchmark.
scientific_disposition.limitation: This closure does not establish that the underlying classifier is non-robust and does not establish a unique sole cause of selector failure.

v037_entry_boundary.purpose: Characterize what the frozen AEGIS evidence implies for threat detection, multimodal failure modes, information-integrity risk, and operational observability without reopening the failed selector correction.
initial_scope: map frozen model/evidence failure modes to information-integrity and threat-intelligence observables
characterize matched versus mismatched and modality-degradation threat surfaces using already-established AEGIS terminology
separate detector/classifier performance, reliability evidence, selector behavior, and intervention behavior
define operational observability and alerting claims that are supported by frozen evidence
identify NOT_AVAILABLE evidence explicitly rather than reconstructing it
preserve no-official-test boundary unless separately authorized

prohibited_after_closure: claim formal robustness was evaluated in v0.36
claim classifier non-robustness from selector ineligibility
new architecture or implementation in v0.36
